family: R4-B4 breakthrough: frozen Kronos-mini embeddings + tiny CPU head, walk-forward (local inference)
hypothesis: A frozen foundation-model embedding of the 5m past (Kronos-mini trunk, never fine-tuned) carries trend/volatility context that a tiny CPU head can map to the v4 action grid better than raw candle40 features. Fresh signal source; untried per ledger round4 B4.

embedding.frame: single 5m frame, L=128 closed bars strictly before the signal bar: candles.iloc[bar_index-128:bar_index]
embedding.normalization: per-window z-norm + clamp(-5,5), identical to KronosPredictor/WindowStore past-only convention
embedding.trunk: embedding + transformer layers + norm (no sampling, no forecast head)
embedding.causality: embedding window ends at the last CLOSED bar before signal_time; bar_index candle itself excluded
embedding.scope: all 5628 decisions (4076 in-window 2023-06-01..2026-03-23 scored OOS; the rest supply mature train labels only)

feasibility.single_pass_estimate_s: <120 for 5628 windows at B=32 incl. window assembly
feasibility.go_criterion: single-pass estimate <= 7200s -> GO local; else STOP with negative audit
feasibility.verdict: GO local (estimate ~2 orders of magnitude under budget)

kronos512: kronos-mini frozen 512-d pooled embedding (NEW signal source)
candle40: examples.npz features (40, frozen control; attributes any gap to source, expect v09 replica)

label: examples.npz labels (n,16,3): channel0 unconditional net percent (0 if unfilled), channel1 OHLC fill indicator, channel2 positive-net given fill. Shared action-value regressors: net on ch0, fill on ch1; prediction ch0 = net/fill (conditional), ch4 = logit(fill). Exactly the v8/train_adaptive_action_model mapping. Exploratory labels on opened development data.
folds: purged monthly walk-forward: for each calendar month M in 2023-06..2026-03, fit_at = first-of-month 00:00Z; train mask = label_end < fit_at - 8d AND signal_time >= fit_at - 730d; predict all decisions with signal_time in M. Embargo 8d >= 7d max holding horizon. Minimum 200 mature train decisions per fit (else STOP with error). 34 fits per feature branch. No threshold/sizing/direction tuning on fold outcomes.

model.note: Exactly v8/v09 hyperparams; no scaling/PCA (trees); single seed (smoke budget, HGB near-deterministic)

policy: Standard choose() with UNCHANGED v5 thresholds (minimum_expected_net_percent 0.3, minimum_fill_score 0.25) + identical frequency loop (cooldown 5d, max 4/month) as the r1a gen_signals replica. Entry/brackets/holding grid [3,7] unchanged. Branches x sizing {1x, dd_guard}; dd_guard = 0.5x while own-branch 1x sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after, past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed) is >10% under its trailing peak, else 1.0 (B1 style).

backtest.execution: entry_expiry 12 bars, max_holding 2016 bars (7d); 1x lev 1.0/1.0; dd_guard lev 0.25/1.0
backtest.duration: monthly_geometric_net = ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1 with duration from parent_plan (2023-06-01 to 2026-03-23)

cloud: Kaggle NOT used: local single-pass estimate (<120s GPU + ~15min CPU HGB) is far under budget, so the fallback condition was never met. No kernel submitted, no dataset created, no credentials loaded.
rules: fit on train-window mature labels only
pre-specified matrix, no changes after backtests
report ALL 4 branches x ALL 3 scenarios
new output dir only; never overwrite
